summary: GSK plc filed a 6-K announcing the commencement of a tender offer via its subsidiary Harmony Row Acquisition Co. to acquire all shares of Nuvalent, Inc. for $124.00 per share in cash. The offer is pursuant to a June 9, 2026 merger agreement, with a subsequent merger under DGCL Section 251(h), requiring no stockholder vote. Nuvalent's board recommends acceptance and filed a Schedule 14D-9. Conditions include a minimum tender of a majority of Class A shares and HSR clearance; no financing condition. The offer expires July 14, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Watch for regulatory timing and any competing bids.
